response.sql: WITH shares AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS a FROM shares) SELECT SUM(s.n) AS total_telescopes, AVG(s.share) AS avg_share, AVG(s.share - av.a) AS avg_excess_over_average FROM shares s CROSS JOIN avg_share av WHERE s.share > av.a

assumptions.assumption: Share of an observatory = its telescope count divided by total telescope count in the telescopes table; the average share is the unweighted mean across observatories that have at least one telescope (observatories with no telescopes are excluded).
Share is expressed as a fraction (0-1), not a percentage.
